Mike (Sales): Quick heads-up — BrightArc asked for pen test / vuln scan artifacts and a remediation timeline by Friday EOD. They want evidence they can hand to their vendor risk team. Can SE/security take point?
Elaine (Solutions Eng): On it. I can package the scan exports and a short remediation plan. Do we have the signed NDA redaction checklist?
Jordan (Security): We have the PT report (internal) and external Nessus/Qualys exports. Will need to redact customer-identifying IPs and PR subject info before sharing. Uploading to secure S3 bucket now.
SecBot: Uploaded report bundle to s3://redwood-sec-evidence/brightarc/1795012345/ (access: presigned, 72h).
Sophie (Customer InfoSec): Can you confirm scope — was Dedicated infra in scope or hosted? Also need CVSS >7 items separated with planned mitigations.
Jordan (Security): Scope: hosted API + dedicated test infra (staging). High-level findings: 3 x CVSS>=7 (two auth bypass patterns, one server header info leak). Low/meds are in separate CSV. Sample qualys output snippet:
```
Plugin ID: 12345 - Server Information Disclosure
Risk: Medium
Solution: Remove/obfuscate server header
```
and
```
Plugin ID: 98765 - Authentication Bypass (high)
Risk: High
Description: Missing MFA enforcement on admin endpoints
```
Elaine (Solutions Eng): Proposed remediation timeline (working draft):
- Day 0-1: Redact & upload artifacts (Jordan)
- Day 1-3: Triage high CVEs, assign owners (Eng/Infra)
- Day 4-10: Remediation sprint + internal validation
- Day 11-14: Patch verification & evidence bundle handed to customer
I'll map owners and link JIRA tickets.
Mike (Sales): Customer asked for resource owner names and dates — can we provide internal POC plus expected ETA per item?
Jordan (Security): Yes. I'll export a table with vulnerability, owner, ETA, mitigation notes. Example row: `CVE-2025-4321 | Jordan (Security) -> Eng-Auth | ETA 2026-04-05 | Mitigation: enforce MFA + token revocation`
Sophie (Customer InfoSec): Good. Also need confirmation that no customer data exfiltrated — can we include audit log summary?
Jordan (Security): Confirmed: no exfil detected. I'll include a 7-day auth/audit log summary and redacted request samples.
Elaine (Solutions Eng): Adding JIRA links and owners now. Will ping when bundle is ready.
Mike (Sales): Thanks team. I'll tell BrightArc we'll deliver preliminary evidence and owner list by Thursday EOD, full remediation timeline by following Monday. :thumbsup:
Elaine (Solutions Eng): Bundle ETA ~ 1795012380 (upload + presigned links).
SecBot: Presigned links generated and emailed to sales@brightarc.com (expires 72h).
